prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a whimsical, animated underwater scene inspired by Pixar-style animation, featuring a single, large-eyed clownfish as the central subject. The clownfish has an exaggeratedly sad, emo-inspired expression, with a dramatic side-swept black hairstyle reminiscent of emo culture. The fish floats alone in the center of the frame, surrounded by softly lit, bluish water with gentle rays of light filtering down from above. The background is filled with blurred, shadowy silhouettes of seaweed and coral, creating a sense of depth and isolation. The color palette is dominated by cool blues and teals, contrasted by the bright orange and white stripes of the clownfish. At the top of the image, bold, playful text reads "FINDING EMO" in a stylized, dripping font, parodying the "Finding Nemo" movie title. The overall mood is both humorous and melancholic, with cinematic lighting, a shallow depth of field, and a focus on the fish’s expressive face to evoke a sense of quirky, underwater drama.
